# fw-depot crate

> depot_tools in Rust: gclient (DEPS, sync, revinfo, getdep/setdep, hooks), a CIPD client, fetch, autoninja, git-cl and Gerrit, presubmit, and the AOSP repo…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-depot/

depot_tools in Rust: gclient (DEPS, sync, revinfo, getdep/setdep, hooks), a CIPD client, fetch, autoninja, git-cl and Gerrit, presubmit, and the AOSP repo manifest, plus the work/span model of a ninja/siso build; ships `fw-depot` (run by `fw depot`)
